record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: A p-multi-norm is a special case of a power-norm. For the power-norm on a Banach space E given by ||(x_1,...,x_n)||_n = integral_0^1 ||sum_{k=1}^n r_k(t)x_k|| dt, where (r_k) are the Rademacher functions, does this example fit into a version of p-multi-norm theory, and is it related to Rademacher-bounded sequences of operators?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E$ be a Banach space, and for each integer $n \ge 1$ let $(r_k)_{k=1}^n$ denote the Rademacher functions on $[0,1]$ (so $r_k(t) = \operatorname{sgn}(\sin(2^k\pi t))$). Define a sequence of norms on the spaces $E^n$ by
$$\|(x_1,\dots,x_n)\|_n \;=\; \int_0^1 \Big\|\sum_{k=1}^n r_k(t)\,x_k\Big\|_E\, dt, \qquad x_1,\dots,x_n \in E.$$
This family $(\|\cdot\|_n)$ is a power-norm on $E$ in the sense that: (i) $\|(x)\|_1 = \|x\|_E$; (ii) $\|\cdot\|_n$ is a norm on $E^n$; (iii) the family is invariant under coordinate permutations; (iv) it is stable under repetition and zero-padding in the appropriate sense. Recall that a $p$-multi-norm ($1 \le p \le \infty$) on $E$ is a power-norm $(\|\cdot\|_n)$ satisfying suitable axioms generalising the multi-norms ($p=\infty$) and dual multi-norms ($p=1$) introduced by Dales and Polyakov; equivalently it can be described via the structure of $\ell_p$-power-norms. A sequence $(T_k)$ of bounded operators on $E$ is called Rademacher-bounded (R-bounded) if there exists $C>0$ such that
$$\int_0^1 \Big\|\sum_{k=1}^n r_k(t)\,T_k x_k\Big\|\,dt \;\le\; C\int_0^1 \Big\|\sum_{k=1}^n r_k(t)\,x_k\Big\|\,dt$$
for all $n$ and all $x_1,\dots,x_n \in E$.

Problem. Determine whether the Rademacher power-norm $(\|\cdot\|_n)$ defined above fits naturally into a version of $p$-multi-norm theory — that is, identify for which value(s) of $p \in [1,\infty]$ (or in what generalized $p$-multi-norm framework) this power-norm is a $p$-multi-norm — and describe the precise relationship between this power-norm and the notion of Rademacher-bounded (R-bounded) sequences of operators on $E$.
artifact.category_tag: Multi-norms and power-norms on Banach spaces
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work on power-normed spaces (Pellegrini–Blasco and related literature) identifies the Rademacher power-norm as a "2-power-norm" and shows that the class of $\ell_p$-power-norms contains the $p$-multi-norms of Dales et al., placing the Rademacher example inside a $p$-multi-norm-style framework. The connection to R-boundedness is also part of this developing theory, though a fully systematic treatment is not yet definitive, so the question is best classified as partially addressed rather than fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Power-normed spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Rademacher power norms are examples of p-power and ℓp-power-norms; the class of ℓp-power-norms contains the p-multi-norms of Dales et al. and coincides with multi-norms and dual multi-norms of Dales–Polyakov.
status_evidence.claim: The Rademacher power-norm is identified as a 2-power-norm and fits into the ℓp-power-norm / p-multi-norm framework.

status_evidence.title: Multi-norms and Banach lattices
status_evidence.snippet: p-multi-norms are defined for 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞; ∞-multi-norms and 1-multi-norms correspond to multi-norms and dual multi-norms respectively.
status_evidence.claim: The p-multi-norm theory used to address the question has been developed for the full range 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞.
